_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Cuberite egg in pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Cuberite
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Cuberite, a fast and light Minecraft Java server written in C++ with Lua plugins, for Minecraft 1.8 to 1.12.2. Installs Cuberite's newest build, checked against its checksum.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Cuberite. Downloads Cuberite's newest build for this CPU from
# Cuberite's build server and checks it against the build's SHA-1. The
# program and its stock assets are replaced; worlds, settings, plugins and
# any file you've edited are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) job=linux-x86_64 ;;
    aarch64) job=linux-aarch64 ;;
    *) fail "Cuberite has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
jenkins="https://builds.cuberite.org/job/$job"
info=$(get "$jenkins/lastSuccessfulBuild/api/json?tree=number") || fail "Cuberite's build server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
build=$(jq -r '.number' <<<"$info")
sum=$(get "$jenkins/$build/artifact/Cuberite.tar.gz.sha1" | cut -d' ' -f1) || fail "Cuberite's build server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."

if [ -x Cuberite ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-cuberite 2>/dev/null)" = "$job $build" ]; then
    echo "Cuberite build $build is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

# Unpacked in the server's folder (the install's /tmp is small), removed at the end.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
echo "Downloading Cuberite build $build"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$work/Cuberite.tar.gz" "$jenkins/$build/artifact/Cuberite.tar.gz"
[ "$(sha1sum "$work/Cuberite.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download didn't match the build's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
mkdir "$work/new"
tar -xzf "$work/Cuberite.tar.gz" -C "$work/new"

# The program, its protocol data, prefabs, web admin pages and notices are
# Cuberite's own: replace them. Everything else (settings, item and mob
# lists, the bundled plugins) is copied only where it isn't there yet.
for f in Cuberite Protocol Prefabs webadmin BACKERS CONTRIBUTORS LICENSE README.txt ThirdPartyLicenses buildinfo.txt; do
    [ -e "$work/new/$f" ] || continue
    rm -rf "$f.new"
    cp -a "$work/new/$f" "$f.new"
    rm -rf "$f"
    mv "$f.new" "$f"
    rm -rf "$work/new/$f"
done
cp -an "$work/new/." .

# The web admin has no users until you add one, so it's off until then.
[ -f webadmin.ini ] || printf '[WebAdmin]\nEnabled=0\nPorts=8080\n' > webadmin.ini

echo "$job $build" > .raptor-cuberite
echo "Installed Cuberite build $build, for Minecraft 1.8 to 1.12.2."
